svg.title: Delete command: Obituary
svg.desc: An agent sends rm -rf build; Obituary blocks this execution without changing it, and tells the agent the equivalent command obit rm -rf build; the agent uses it, the item enters the graveyard, and obit resurrect <id> puts it back with one command.
